purpose: Candidate scripts for dialogue-manager testing; not all should be used verbatim in production.
usage_rules: One question at a time unless two details are tightly linked.
Do not speak while worker is still speaking.
Emergency policy must be configured with the actual site owner.
Ask local speakers to review dialect wording.
Never submit a normal report without confirmation.

scripts.worker_utterance: Machine band ho gayi hai.
scripts.bot_response: Kaunsi location par machine band hui hai—site ka naam aur area bata sakte hain?
scripts.notes: Core hand-authored conversation example.

scripts.worker_utterance: Pump kaam nahi kar raha.
scripts.bot_response: Pump kis area ya bay mein hai?
scripts.notes: Core hand-authored conversation example.

scripts.worker_utterance: The conveyor has stopped.
scripts.bot_response: Where on site is the conveyor located?
scripts.notes: Core hand-authored conversation example.

scripts.worker_utterance: Machine ID shayad one zero seven hai.
scripts.bot_response: ID confirm kar dein: 107, ya koi aur number?
scripts.notes: Core hand-authored conversation example.

scripts.worker_utterance: Paanch ya pandrah bag chahiye.
scripts.bot_response: Aapne 5 bags kaha ya 15 bags?
scripts.notes: Core hand-authored conversation example.

scripts.worker_utterance: Twenty chahiye.
scripts.bot_response: Twenty kis cheez ke aur kaunsi unit mein—bags, pieces ya kg?
scripts.notes: Core hand-authored conversation example.

scripts.worker_utterance: Kal hua tha, ya parson shayad.
scripts.bot_response: Exact din confirm nahi hai; kya main report mein 'approx. 1–2 days ago' likhun?
scripts.notes: Core hand-authored conversation example.

scripts.worker_utterance: It stopped at 10. No, maybe 12.
scripts.bot_response: Was it 10 or 12? I’ll keep the time unconfirmed until you clarify.
scripts.notes: Core hand-authored conversation example.

scripts.worker_utterance: Nahi, 15 nahi, 50 kg.
scripts.bot_response: Understood—50 kg, not 15 kg. Is that correct?
scripts.notes: Core hand-authored conversation example.

scripts.worker_utterance: Umm... matlab... aur ek issue hai.
scripts.bot_response: Ji, batayein—main sun raha hoon.
scripts.notes: Core hand-authored conversation example.

scripts.worker_utterance: Bas... ek aur cheez.
scripts.bot_response: Haan, batayein. Main abhi report final nahi kar raha.
scripts.notes: Core hand-authored conversation example.

scripts.worker_utterance: Report: pump P07, Bay 2, oil leak. Submit?
scripts.bot_response: I heard: oil leak at pump P07 in Bay 2. Should I submit this report?
scripts.notes: Core hand-authored conversation example.

scripts.worker_utterance: Nahi, Bay 2 nahi, Bay 3.
scripts.bot_response: Theek hai, location Bay 3 kar raha hoon. Baaki details sahi hain?
scripts.notes: Core hand-authored conversation example.

scripts.worker_utterance: Wire se sparks aa rahe hain aur log paas hain.
scripts.bot_response: Yeh urgent safety issue ho sakta hai. Safe distance rakhein aur site emergency procedure/supervisor ko abhi alert karein. Main urgent report bana raha hoon.
scripts.notes: Core hand-authored conversation example.

scripts.worker_utterance: The motor stopped; I don't know why.
scripts.bot_response: I'll record the motor stopped and the cause is unknown. Where is it located?
scripts.notes: Core hand-authored conversation example.

scripts.worker_utterance: Naam nahi dena.
scripts.bot_response: Theek hai. Agar policy allow karti hai, main bina naam ke report continue karta hoon.
scripts.notes: Core hand-authored conversation example.

scripts.worker_utterance: Noise bahut hai, dobara bolta hoon.
scripts.bot_response: Koi baat nahi. Sirf machine ID ya location dobara bata dein.
scripts.notes: Core hand-authored conversation example.

scripts.worker_utterance: I have to go, just send it.
scripts.bot_response: I still need you to confirm the key details. I can save this as a draft or follow the site's urgent escalation policy.
scripts.notes: Core hand-authored conversation example.

scripts.worker_utterance: Machine band aa ji, gate de kol.
scripts.bot_response: Samajh aaya—gate ke paas machine band hai. Gate ka naam/number aur machine ID pata hai?
scripts.notes: Core hand-authored conversation example.

scripts.worker_utterance: Cement kam hai, around twenty bags.
scripts.bot_response: I’ll note approximately 20 cement bags. Which store or work area needs them?
scripts.notes: Core hand-authored conversation example.
